_note: PARENT'S (clinic). What the staff's 'Aaj ka kaam' list needs beyond claude_code_briefs/DUTY_MAP.json (D648), which stays the one list of every duty that has a queryable state: (1) 'from' -- NOTHING BEFORE THIS DAY IS SHOWN OR COUNTED (the owner, 05-Oct-2026, D679: 'use from current month only, and the leftovers of September'); the setting duties.from overrides it. (2) 'floor' -- the dated tables the floor is laid under: aaj_kaam.py shadows each with a TEMP view (rows on or after the floor only) on its own read-only connection, so the duty map's SQL is run unedited; 'first_of' moves a table's floor forward to the first day ANOTHER table has a row (a clinic day is a counter-sheet duty only since the counter sheet exists). (3) 'works' -- a login that works other queues as well as its own. (4) 'extra' -- the parent's lines the map does not hold: kind 'sql' (one read-only SELECT returning n and since, as the map's), kind 'tick' (no state in the database: the person taps 'Ho gaya' -- one row in duty_tick, who and when; period day / week / month), kind 'fetch' (the count lives behind another app's own door; the page reads that door with the person's own login). Texts: 'hi' Roman Hinglish for the person, 'en' English for the owner's console. Offered to DUTY_MAP.json at the session's close; until then this file is the only place they live. 'ok_hi' -- how a line reads in the list's 'nothing pending' part. 'console': 'fact' -- the owner's console already says this as a fact line of its own (yesterday's two Docterz exports), so it is not repeated under the person there; the staff's list carries it.

extra.hi: Pichhle din ki Docterz Consultation report server par nahin aayi
extra.how_hi: Reception PC par Docterz se report nikaliye -- wo apne aap server par chali jaati hai. Call Tracker aur Revenue isi par chalte hain.
extra.en: Docterz Consultation report of {since} has not reached the server (reception)
extra.sql: WITH d(day) AS (SELECT CASE strftime('%w', date('now','localtime','-1 day')) WHEN '0' THEN date('now','localtime','-2 day') ELSE date('now','localtime','-1 day') END) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT day FROM d) >= (SELECT MIN(business_date) FROM docterz_export) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM docterz_export e WHERE e.kind = 'consultation' AND e.business_date = (SELECT day FROM d) AND e.status = 'current') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS n, (SELECT day FROM d) AS since
extra.ok_hi: Pichhle din ki Docterz Consultation report server par aa gayi

extra.hi: Pichhle din ki Docterz Follow-up log server par nahin aayi
extra.how_hi: Reception PC par Docterz se report nikaliye -- wo apne aap server par chali jaati hai. Call Tracker aur Revenue isi par chalte hain.
extra.en: Docterz Follow-up log of {since} has not reached the server (reception)
extra.sql: WITH d(day) AS (SELECT CASE strftime('%w', date('now','localtime','-1 day')) WHEN '0' THEN date('now','localtime','-2 day') ELSE date('now','localtime','-1 day') END) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT day FROM d) >= (SELECT MIN(business_date) FROM docterz_export) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM docterz_export e WHERE e.kind = 'followup' AND e.business_date = (SELECT day FROM d) AND e.status = 'current' AND (COALESCE(e.due_to,'') = '' OR e.due_to >= (CASE strftime('%w', date((SELECT day FROM d),'+1 day')) WHEN '0' THEN date((SELECT day FROM d),'+2 day') ELSE date((SELECT day FROM d),'+1 day') END))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS n, (SELECT day FROM d) AS since
extra.ok_hi: Pichhle din ki Docterz Follow-up log server par aa gayi

extra.sql: WITH k(kind) AS (VALUES ('consultation'), ('followup')) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, date('now','localtime') AS since FROM k WHERE strftime('%H','now','localtime') >= '19' AND strftime('%w','now','localtime') <> '0' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM docterz_export e WHERE e.kind = k.kind AND e.business_date = date('now','localtime') AND e.status = 'current' AND (e.kind <> 'followup' OR COALESCE(e.due_to,'') = '' OR e.due_to >= (CASE strftime('%w', date('now','localtime','+1 day')) WHEN '0' THEN date('now','localtime','+2 day') ELSE date('now','localtime','+1 day') END)))
